answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 7236 Country: GY Title: Is it permissible to give a woman talaaq during the 40 days period after childbirth if a man give his wife talaaq during this period is it valid. Question: Is it permissible to give a woman talaaq during the 40 days period after childbirth if a man give his wife talaaq during this period is it valid. Answer ID: 7236 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 851/851=M/1429) The blood which is discharged after childbirth is called nifas (postpartum period). The husband has been prohibited to pronounce divorce in a state of haiz or nifas . However, if anyone gives divorce to his wife during this period ( nifas ), the divorce will take place but the man will be a sinner to for giving the divorce in such state. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
